metadata.explanation: Task requires changing all file permissions to 600 (rw-------). Evaluator verifies all files in testDir have exactly 600 permissions (owner read-write only).
metadata.verification: Verified with bash script logic - evaluator checks file permissions using stat -c %a to get octal permission mode. Setup creates 3 files: file1.txt (755), file2.txt (644), file3.txt (777). Script finds all regular files recursively using 'find testDir -type f' and verifies each has exactly 600 permissions.
metadata.eval_script_note: The eval.sh script has been implemented and needs to be uploaded to the HuggingFace cache location specified in postconfig. Script behavior: (1) finds all regular files in testDir recursively, (2) checks each file's permissions using stat -c %a, (3) verifies each has exactly 600 permissions, (4) outputs 'All files have 600 permissions.' only if all files pass, otherwise outputs 'X out of Y files have 600 permissions.' for partial credit.
